generation.mode: built-in imagegen edit with the edit target first and the canon second as reference only

lighting_isotropy.metric: 36-bin land-luminance-gradient magnitude peak divided by uniform-bin mean; water-mask pixels and gradients below 12 luminance units excluded
lighting_isotropy.visual_check: No whole-cell cast-shadow field, sun angle, or time-of-day gradient is visible, but several rounded boulders and conifer crowns retain brighter upper or upper-left values and darker lower values. The strict same-value-all-round rule is not met.

median_conifer_crown_final_scale.measurement: Median connected dark-green crown width across 49 isolated candidate conifer components, scaled by 2560/1254; diagnostic overlay is diagnostics/c0-1-conifer-components.png. The threshold can omit lighter branch tips, but numerous complete visible crowns remain below the required source-scale floor.

buildable_vs_steep_fraction.basis: manual estimated fraction of non-water land area
buildable_vs_steep_fraction.method: The broad central and southeastern level meadow shelf and its open southern draw count as buildable; only the immediate grassy shore brow and short-fall banks count as steep; shingle, rounded outcrops, rough meadow, and conifer stands make up the remainder.

water_mask.encoding: opaque white water pixels on fully transparent non-water pixels; binary alpha
water_mask.derivation: Source-raster colour classification constrained by broad water search windows, followed by painted-pixel connectivity growth, local closure, enclosed-hole filling, and largest-component retention. The boundary follows painted wet pixels; no polyline supplies it.
water_mask.component_note: The sound, short fall, stream, and pool form one visibly connected painted water system.

final_canvas_gate_reproduction.note: The installed Node executable was denied by the managed shell, so the repository formula was reproduced locally with System.Drawing at the source radii equivalent to 6 px and 48 px on the 2560 px final canvas.

open_risks: Hard scale failure: the measured median connected crown width is about 51.037 px / 2.450 m at final scale, below the required 84-147 px / 4-7 m range; several visible crowns are smaller still.
Hard lighting failure: the rock-lighting first moment is 0.201744 against the 0.15 proxy limit, and individual boulders and conifers visibly retain brighter upper values and darker lower values.
The luminous shelf is warmer and brighter than the arriving coast, but whether the tonal lift is the required two perceptual steps and whether the seam is invisible remain human visual judgments.

The official Node authoring gate was unavailable because execution of the installed node.exe was denied; dimensions, alpha, topology, water footprint, lighting statistics, and the 6 px / 48 px water rings were reproduced locally with System.Drawing.
Seam continuity, water-mask judgment, and overall visual quality remain director and owner decisions; this report does not claim visual acceptance.
